description: This file is a unit test class for the PartialTheme Data Transfer Object (DTO) in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin. It tests the creation of a PartialTheme instance from a Theme entity, verifying that specific properties are correctly set.

classes.name: PartialThemeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the PartialTheme DTO creation from a Theme entity within the Corporate Branding plugin.

methods.name: setUp

methods.name: testCreateFromTheme
